text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, a crowd 
had gathered in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? It's super lively over there, isn't 
it? I wonder what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Special-Grade Carrot Hamburg Steak?! Whoa, 
let's do it, let's do it, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Do you have a raffle ticket?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! Umm, then I'll go do some quick 
shopping!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I accidentally bought way too many 
ingredients. If I win the carrots, there's 
so many things I want to make.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do this~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono enthusiastically turned the 
lottery wheel handle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What do I do~, it's an "Onsen Trip 
Voucher"~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and this ryokan! It's super famous for 
having exceptionally buono food~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! Let's go together, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're okay with me joining?
Are you sure you want me to come with you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course～☆ Having a super delicious meal 
together is bound to make us so happy, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but you're a bit busy right now, 
right? There are tons of races coming up 
and all~...
choice_data_list: Want to do it once you've calmed down?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right~. We'll definitely be 
able to take it easy that way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, this stays locked away until 
then. I'll keep it safe and sound for you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I wonder what kind of food we'll 
get~. Sashimi, maybe steak, or hot pot~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It'll definitely be a great learning 
experience, so we have to make sure we 
remember the flavor well before heading 
home~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure our tummies are super 
empty before we go, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a new promise was born between 
Hishi Akebono and me.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Waaah! It looks sooooooo delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Is this... Whoaaa, it's a 
hamburg steak from that super famous 
restaurant~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to go eat there 
someday. Woow, it's like a miracle~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yep♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but Trainer, why don't you eat with 
me too~?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Delicious food tastes twice as 
good when you eat it together~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When you eat with someone you love, it 
tastes four times as delicious! Isn't that 
amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Alright, now that that's settled, 
let's head straight home~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I bought tons of ingredients, so I might 
as well add soup and salad too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we thoroughly savored a truly 
delicious "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, having mastered the recipe, 
Hishi Akebono brought over an exact 
recreation of the flavor— but that's a 
story for another time.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Yay, yay, yaaay! I can make lots of 
dishes now~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Nikujaga, curry, stew, carrot hamburg 
steak, carrot steak, carrot salad, plus 
cake and jelly!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eat to your heart's content and be filled 
with happiness tonight, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm very glad she's so enthusiastic, 
but... that amount might be a bit too much 
for just the two of us.
choice_data_list:
Could it be too much for just the two of 
you to finish?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right! We might have ended up 
with leftovers. That was a close one~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, alright then, I'll go talk to 
everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Maya-chan? I was thinking of 
throwing a carrot party with everyone 
today, what do you say~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, got it♪ Okay, see you later~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, they said they'll come! Yay~☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, then there's Curren-chan, 
Biko-chan, and Kawakami-chan. I wonder if 
Fuji-san and Hishi Ama-san will come too~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha, I hope everyone has a lively time. 
Can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dinner that evening was even livelier than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"So close~! But still, that looks like a 
super yummy carrot~☆"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Heavy, slender, with evenly spaced 
whiskers! I bet it's super sweet and 
tender~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Which means—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Since we have the chance, let's make 
nishime! I'm sure it'll be super buono♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Hishi Akebono cooked and 
treated me to some "buono" stewed 
vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: There's still plenty of seconds~☆

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Aw man, a blank~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, and here I really wanted to treat you 
to a super buono dinner, too~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still, nothing we can do about it! 
Instead, I'll cook you a feast with the 
veggies we just bought~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There are days like this, there are days 
like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she said that, she looked a little 
disappointed as we left the shopping 
district behind.
